name: lifeline-monorepo
description: Lifeline Health & Wellness Platform - Full Stack Application

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:api && npm run install:client
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:client
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:client
scripts.clean: npm run clean:api && npm run clean:client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:db
scripts.setup:db: cd api && npm run generate && npm run migrate

author: Lifeline Team
